title: 三个数的最大乘积
summary: 从整数数组中选择三个数，求它们乘积的最大值。
insight: 最优组合只可能是三个最大值，或两个最小负数与一个最大值；一次扫描维护这五个极值即可。
pitfalls: 两个绝对值很大的负数可能胜过次大正数
中间乘积用长整数表达更稳妥

solutions.title: 维护三大两小极值
solutions.idea: 扫描数组更新三个最大值和两个最小值，比较两种候选。
steps: 初始化 first、second、third 为最小值，low1、low2 为最大值

code.java: class Solution { public int maximumProduct(int[] nums){int first=Integer.MIN_VALUE,second=Integer.MIN_VALUE,third=Integer.MIN_VALUE,low1=Integer.MAX_VALUE,low2=Integer.MAX_VALUE;for(int value:nums){if(value>=first){third=second;second=first;first=value;}else if(value>=second){third=second;second=value;}else if(value>third)third=value;if(value<=low1){low2=low1;low1=value;}else if(value<low2)low2=value;}return(int)Math.max((long)first*second*third,(long)first*low1*low2);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maximumProduct(nums:IntArray):Int{var first=Int.MIN_VALUE;var second=Int.MIN_VALUE;var third=Int.MIN_VALUE;var low1=Int.MAX_VALUE;var low2=Int.MAX_VALUE;for(value in nums){if(value>=first){third=second;second=first;first=value}else if(value>=second){third=second;second=value}else if(value>third)third=value;if(value<=low1){low2=low1;low1=value}else if(value<low2)low2=value};return maxOf(first.toLong()*second*third,first.toLong()*low1*low2).toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int maximumProduct(vector<int>& nums){int first=INT_MIN,second=INT_MIN,third=INT_MIN,low1=INT_MAX,low2=INT_MAX;for(int value:nums){if(value>=first){third=second;second=first;first=value;}else if(value>=second){third=second;second=value;}else if(value>third)third=value;if(value<=low1){low2=low1;low1=value;}else if(value<low2)low2=value;}return max(1LL*first*second*third,1LL*first*low1*low2);} };
